description: [Local only — write] Uploads push credentials to Pushizo by reading a key FILE on this machine and validates them with the provider. Pass file PATHS only: never ask the user to paste a key, never read the key file yourself and never put its contents in a tool call. Text secrets (client secret, .p12 password, VAPID private key) are given as a `*_file` path or the NAME of an environment variable. Returns status only (active/invalid, error code, hint, file fingerprint). Replaces the stored credentials of that channel; get explicit approval first. apns: key_file (.p8 with team_id, bundle_id, environment; key_id is read from AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8, or .p12 with optional p12_password_*). fcm: key_file (Firebase service account .json). hms: hms_app_id + client_secret_*. adm: client_id + client_secret_*. wns: package_sid + client_secret_*. webpush: subject (+ site_url; a VAPID key pair is generated unless given). Required scope: admin.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

client_secret_env.description: NAME of an environment variable of this server process that holds the client secret (never the value itself).

client_secret_file.description: File holding the client secret (HMS, ADM, WNS). Path relative to the working directory of this server (or PUSHIZO_CREDENTIALS_DIR); files outside it are refused.

confirm_project_change.description: FCM: confirm switching to a different Firebase project (existing Android tokens become invalid).

high_priority.description: HMS: high-priority data messages (needs Huawei approval).

hms_app_id.description: Huawei AppGallery Connect numeric App ID.

key_file.description: APNs .p8/.p12 or Firebase service account .json file. Path relative to the working directory of this server (or PUSHIZO_CREDENTIALS_DIR); files outside it are refused.

key_id.description: APNs Key ID (10 characters); read from the file name when omitted.

p12_password_env.description: NAME of an environment variable of this server process that holds the .p12 password (never the value itself).

p12_password_file.description: File holding the .p12 password. Path relative to the working directory of this server (or PUSHIZO_CREDENTIALS_DIR); files outside it are refused.

subject.description: Web Push VAPID subject: mailto:address or https URL.

vapid_private_key_env.description: NAME of an environment variable of this server process that holds the existing VAPID private key (never the value itself).

vapid_private_key_file.description: File holding the existing VAPID private key. Path relative to the working directory of this server (or PUSHIZO_CREDENTIALS_DIR); files outside it are refused.

vapid_public_key.description: Existing VAPID public key (only when migrating existing subscribers).

name: upload_channel_credentials
title: Upload push credentials from a file
